info.title: EduPulse API
info.description: Response-adaptive academic intervention and learning analytics system. Cycle: records -> Random Forest state -> eligibility rules -> linear Thompson sampling -> intervention -> follow-up -> reward -> policy update -> state reassessment.

post.description:
Authenticate with email (or a student's roll number) + password; returns a bearer token and the
user (with role for redirect).
OAuth2 form login (used by the Swagger 'Authorize' button).

get.description: Students the caller may see (student: self; faculty: assigned; admin: all) with latest state.

post.description: Run Random Forest inference on the student's current records and store the result.

Bulk-import academic records from CSV. All-or-nothing: if any row is invalid, nothing is stored
and every row error is reported. Columns: roll_number (or student_id), record_type, then the fields
of that record type; `topic` and `assignment` accept a name/title or an id.

get.description:
All stored academic records of one student, newest first. `locked` records are evidence for an
intervention result and cannot be corrected.

patch.description:
Correct a mistaken academic record. The reason and before/after values go to the audit log, and
the student's state is re-estimated from the corrected data (a new, separate state row).

post.description: Re-estimate state if stale -> eligibility rules -> linear Thompson sampling -> record assignment.
Record the post-intervention follow-up score (same topic, 0-100). Optionally evaluate at once.
Compute reward + category, update the Thompson sampling policy (once), reassess the state.
Start a fresh policy version from the prior (e.g. after changing lambda/v). History is kept.

file.title: File
file.description: CSV file, UTF-8, one record per row

email.title: Email
email.description: Email address, or a student's roll number as username

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the record is being corrected (stored in the audit log)

RecordCorrectionIn.title: RecordCorrectionIn
RecordCorrectionIn.description: Only the measured values can be corrected; who/what the record is about cannot.

evaluate.title: Evaluate
evaluate.description: Evaluate and update the policy immediately

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Optional RNG seed, to reproduce a selection exactly
